app.name: PureSlides
app.description: Write a deck in HTML and present it — slides that build, a board that IS the markup, and a PDF, image set or video out the other end.

createEntities.label: Slide deck
createEntities.description: Create a new HTML slide deck.
createEntities.template:
Untitled deck

Write slides in HTML. Present them. Export a PDF.

tools.name: cancelDrawerRequest
tools.description: Cancel the saved pending request by ID. Subsequent commits are refused. Does not undo a completed save.

tools.name: getDrawerRequest
tools.description: Read the saved request, exact HTML/baseHash, edit scope, assets and design guide.

tools.name: commitDrawerRequest
tools.description: Commit the saved request once. Draft/edit: supply complete html preserving everything outside the saved selection. Describe: supply descriptions only from actual image pixels. Returns persisted status, not layout certification.

tools.name: getDeckContext
tools.description: What deck is open, and what the author is aiming at. Returns title, slide count, frame size, `hash` (the content hash of the deck — pass it as baseHash on every edit), `verification` (whether the board's render is verified, being checked, or failed with the overlapping slides named), the brief, the assets with each file's role and description, which pane is up, and `aim` — the scope a request like "this" or "these" refers to: picked elements, ticked slides, or the slide on screen. Read this before acting on a request that points at something rather than naming it, and read it again after any refusal that says the deck changed.

tools.name: getSlide
tools.description: The full HTML of one slide, or of the whole deck when no index is given. Also returns `hash`, the base to pass as baseHash on the edit you make from it.

index.description: Slide number from listSlides; omit for the whole deck.

tools.name: listSlides
tools.description: Every slide in order: index, headline, support line, speaker notes, build steps, hold seconds and any asset it shows — with the deck `hash` to pass as baseHash on the next edit.

tools.name: listAssets
tools.description: Files in the deck's assets folder, with each one's role and description. A file whose role is 'reference' is a design reference: build the look from it and never place it on a slide.

tools.name: checkDeck
tools.description: Lint the deck before presenting or exporting: a missing deck root, build steps that skip a number, images, fonts or scripts loaded over the network, document.write calls that would erase the deck — and `layout`, the render's verification state: 'verified' (every slide measured cleanly with fonts loaded), 'checking' (not every slide has been measured in a visible frame with loaded fonts yet), or 'failed' with the slides whose text overlaps. Export refuses anything that is not verified.

tools.name: createDeck
tools.description: Start a new deck package and open it.

title.description: What the deck is called; names the file too.

tools.name: setDeck
tools.description: Replace the whole deck document, and optionally its frame size or title. Use for a wholesale rewrite; prefer the slide tools for ordinary work. The deck as it was is snapshotted to history first (restoreRevision brings it back); the result reports textRemoved when the rewrite dropped much of the text. Pass baseHash from your read — a stale one is refused.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: addSlide
tools.description:
Add a slide. One element carrying data-slide; put the headline in an

and the second line in a

so the board can edit them.

atIndex.description: Insert before this slide; omit to append.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: updateSlide
tools.description: Change a slide's copy, notes, kind, asset or hold time without rewriting its markup.

notes.description: Speaker notes — presenter view only, never on the slide.

seconds.description: How long it holds in a timed export.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: setSlideHtml
tools.description: Replace one slide's markup entirely, leaving every other slide alone.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: moveSlide
tools.description: Reorder a slide.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: duplicateSlide
tools.description: Copy a slide in place.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: deleteSlide
tools.description: Remove a slide. Refused when it is the last one — a deck keeps at least one slide.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: setElement
tools.description: Replace ONE element inside one slide, leaving the rest untouched. getDeckContext reports the elements the author picked, with their paths.

path.description: Chain of child indexes from the slide, such as "0.2".

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: setElementText
tools.description: Retype ONE element's words, leaving its markup and styling exactly as they are. Use this rather than setElement when only the text changes — it cannot disturb the layout. Refused on an element that holds other elements, since writing text into it would delete them.

path.description: Chain of child indexes from the slide, such as "0.2".

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: listBlocks
tools.description: The slide compositions on offer — title, statement, points that build, cards, two-column, full-bleed image, full-bleed video, video in a frame, screenshot, quote, number, before-and-after, sequence, agenda, divider, end card. Each says what it is FOR and how many presses it takes. Reach for these rather than inventing a layout: a deck written from nothing comes out as fifteen headline-and-bullets slides.

tools.name: addBlock
tools.description: Add one of the compositions from listBlocks as a new slide, then edit it like any other. Faster and more varied than writing a layout from scratch. The video blocks (video-full, video) take `asset`: the clip's file name in assets/ (addAsset it first) goes into the block's slot, so the slide plays it when it comes up.

atIndex.description: Insert before this slide; omit to append.

asset.description: For a video block: the clip's file name inside assets/ (from listAssets or addAsset) — `demo.mp4`, not a path. MP4 (H.264) plays everywhere.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: deleteElement
tools.description: Remove ONE element from a slide — a line, an image, a block the author pointed at. Rewriting it as something empty is not the same: the box, its spacing and its build step stay behind.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: setElementStep
tools.description: Put an element on a build step, so it arrives on the Nth press. Step 0 clears it — the element is on from the start. This is how a slide becomes progressive.

step.description: 1 or more to build it in; 0 to show it from the start.

baseHash.description: The deck hash from your last getDeckContext/getSlide/listSlides read. When it no longer matches, the edit is refused with the current hash — re-read and redo it. Optional for now; always pass it.

tools.name: addAsset
tools.description: Copy a file from the workspace into the deck's assets folder so a slide can reference it by relative path.

role.description: What the file is for. 'reference' is a design reference the look is built from and never shown.

tools.name: setAssetRole
tools.description: Mark what an attached file is for: content, design reference, or logo.

tools.name: describeAsset
tools.description: Write what an attached file shows, in one plain sentence. Descriptions are what slides get written from.

tools.name: setBrief
tools.description: Set the brief the deck is drafted from, and roughly how many slides it should run to.

tools.name: draftDeck
tools.description: Prepare and save a deck composition request. Returns context and design guide immediately; no model call. Compose the complete deck in this drawer, then commitDrawerRequest and checkDeck.

tools.name: setSelection
tools.description: Aim the app: choose the slide on screen, tick a set of slides, pick elements, or switch pane. Use it to SHOW the author what you are talking about before you change it.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Open the deck full screen from a slide, as if the author pressed Present.

tools.name: saveDeck
tools.description: Save the current deck into its app-managed .deck package and return the durable artifact path. Call this after deck edits before completing a mission.

tools.name: exportDeck
tools.description: Export the deck: 'pdf' (one page per slide, every build revealed — the PDF is the board's render, printed; a video prints as its poster or a panel naming the clip), 'images' (a PNG per slide), 'pptx' (a PowerPoint file: one picture slide per slide, the board's render, speaker notes attached, every video placed as a real clip that plays; opens in PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides, text is a picture not type) or 'video' (slides on a clock through the frame renderer). The pipeline measures every slide again first and REFUSES when the layout is not verified: a slide with overlapping text, a check that could not finish (the app hidden, fonts not loaded), or a checkDeck error. A refusal names the slides; fix them and call again. There is no way around the check.

notesAppendix.description: PDF only: add a speaker-notes appendix.

tools.name: stopExport
tools.description: Stop a running export after the page or frame in flight.

tools.name: listRevisions
tools.description: List the deck's revision snapshots, newest first. A snapshot is the deck AS IT WAS before a change: every ask from the board, every setDeck/slide/element tool call, every draft and every restore copies the previous version into the package's history/ folder first (12 kept per deck). Each entry reports file, at, reason (ask / agent / agent-setDeck / draft / manual-edit / restore), scope, byteSize and textChars — compare textChars across entries to see where content went missing. Call this before restoreRevision.

tools.name: restoreRevision
tools.description: Put a revision snapshot back as the open deck — the same restore as the board's Undo and History list. Use it when a rewrite (yours or an earlier one) lost content the user wanted kept: an edit result reports textRemoved when a large share of the visible text vanished. The current deck is snapshotted first (reason "restore"), so a restore is itself undoable and never loses the present version. Pass the file name exactly as listRevisions reports it.

file.description: The snapshot's file name from listRevisions (e.g. 2026-09-02T10-15-30-123Z-ask.html).
